facts.fact: Packet Clearing House's directory lists the Somali Internet Exchange Point (SoIXP) in Mogadishu, run by the National Communications Authority Somalia and established 20 November 2018, with status Active.
The African IXP Association's undated list of exchange points, retrieved 2026-11-09, names for Somalia: SoIXP, Mogadishu.

note: Somalia is named only as a neighbour of Kenya's land links.
Submarine cables only; no exchange point stated.
